description: Details of all new and replacement window types with details including glazing bar profiles at 1:2 or 1:1, including any existing context for comparison, detailed sections and showing the context of the existing brick reveal, details of glazing bars and existing and proposed sections, detail must be provided which should include timber frames that are in keeping with historic timber profiles found at the building, details of the dimensions of the ASHP and details of the materiality and treatment of the associated acoustic enclosure in the form of photographs, condition surveys, method statements and details (as specified below) prior to commencing works in relation to the  existing and proposed floor build ups, strategy for historic floor boards- floor boards detailed repair written methodology to demonstrate that any associated works would be sensitively carried out without harm to historic fabric and the special interest, existing condition survey and heritage assessment, and proposed drawings of the rear french door at first floor of the principal building, which must be sympathetic to the special interest of the building and details of any new proposed railings at rear courtyard pursuant to conditions 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 (a-c) and 12 of listed building dated 22nd April 2025 (RN:24/05919/LBC)
